headline: Nigerian manufacturers report inability to compete with Chinese imports
summary: The Manufacturers Association of Nigeria (MAN) stated that local producers cannot compete with Chinese manufacturers and is demanding lower interest rates and improved power infrastructure.
why: Manufacturing competitiveness is a key driver of industrial output and employment in emerging economies like Nigeria, which faces challenges with infrastructure and financing costs.

impacts.name: Nigerian Manufacturing
impacts.why: Local manufacturers face significant competitive pressure from lower-cost imports.
